script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmos is throwing a lightning bolt straight at your life path right now. Mars, your ruling planet, is sparking a volatile square to Saturn in your 10th House of Career. Avoid making any sudden departures today, because an unexpected financial blessing is quietly heading your way. Follow for the reading to see how this explosive energy will finally resolve.
